ned.name: Ned Furrowe
ned.about: a neat civil hand that goes tight when he lies

abel.name: Abel Furrowe
abel.about: an old man's copperplate, shaky but proud: big capitals, full shades, looped

will.name: Sergeant Will Brack
will.about: a militia sergeant's blunt print in pencil: pressed hard, each stroke stopped dead and dug in, uneven

tomas.name: Tomas Haldane
tomas.about: a hurried hand: wide, leaning, joined, dots dashed, the line climbing

anni.name: Anni Haldane
anni.about: a careful fourteen-year-old's print in pencil: letters pressed hard then light, the line wandering, the grain of the pencil in every stroke; her tally fives drawn square

holt.name: Captain Holt, the Requisition Captain (named in content/quota/q_ned.lwd)
holt.about: the Arlen school hand over a cottar's grip: taught loops, upright, pressed hard and stiff

mott.name: Walter Mott
mott.about: a trained clerk's ledger hand: a small broad nib, an even slope, looped ascenders, every letter joined

bet.name: Bet Haldane
bet.about: a slow, uncertain hand: wobbling strokes, some gone over twice, heavy where the pen rests, the line sinking, phonetic spelling

pask.name: Commissioner Pask
pask.about: a soft official round hand: wide round letters, light pressure, gently looped

ilo.name: Ilo Haldane (content/quota/q_world.lwd q.ilo)
ilo.about: Hesh letters, fluent and quick (the Hesh script is provisional until the author approves it); Tarnish written as a learned second hand, careful but laboured, each letter built on its own, the Hesh headline kept over each word
